title: Investigating the impact of Integrated Curriculum of Geometry and Piet Mondrian’s Artwork in Louvre Abu Dhabi on Students’ Attainment and Progress in Mathematics-An Abu Dhabi School Case Study
content: This paper presents a case study using an exploratory method for investigating the integrated curriculum of Piet Mondrian’s artwork in Louvre-Abu Dhabi and the geometry precisely circles and circumference. Twenty-five students selected based on their advanced level in mathematics in grade 10 from a Cycle 3 girl public school in Abu Dhabi. The school has implemented the Louvre Ambassadors Program for 2 years from 2019 to 2021; to enhance the use of place-based learning (PBE) through museum education for promoting students’ academic achievement and students’ wellbeing. The result of this study demonstrated the 3 lessons of geometry integrated with Piet Mondrian conducted in Louvre Abu Dhabi; showed effective pace on students’ attainment and progress in mathematics while applying their learning in real-life activity.
